# Integration with LandR Biomass

<!-- SCAFFOLD: structure only. Eliot to supply the specifics -- which objects
     pass between fireSense and LandR Biomass, the order modules must be
     scheduled in, and a pointer to a project that does this. See #2. -->

fireSense's sub-models respond to vegetation as well as to climate, so a
prediction run is usually coupled to a model that simulates how vegetation
changes.
In the LandR ecosystem that model is LandR Biomass, documented in its own manual
at <https://landr-manual.predictiveecology.org/>.

Coupling the two means fire affects vegetation and vegetation affects subsequent
fire within a single simulation, rather than either being treated as a fixed
input to the other.

This section needs the practical detail: what a coupled project schedules, which
objects the two sets of modules exchange, and where a worked example lives.
